The author name is embedded within the title as is common in historical book references.
2. Wrapped the Fleury entry in <BIBL>...</BIBL> tags, as it was missing its BIBL container unlike the other bibliographic entries.

4. Corrected "avelichem" to "adelichem" (likely OCR error for "adelichem" meaning "noble").
5. Fixed "Sub. scriptionen" to "Sub­scriptionen" (removing erroneous space/period break in the word)."}
